name: BioASQ
description: A biomedical semantic indexing and question answering challenge dataset from the annual BioASQ competition. Contains biomedical questions with answers sourced from PubMed articles, including yes/no, factoid, list, and summary question types.
evaluation_method: F1, exact match, ROUGE (for summary questions)
typical_sota_score: varies by task type; ~70-80% on factoid questions
reputation: Longstanding annual biomedical NLP competition; used to evaluate medical knowledge in LLMs; expert-level biomedical questions
notes: Annual competition since 2013 with multiple phases including document retrieval, question classification, and answer generation. Covers multiple biomedical QA formats.

institutions: Athens University of Economics and Business
